criteria.description: The executor exposes ExecuteRecovery with ServiceKey, RecipeName, TargetProfile, PrimaryWorkerPubKey, SelectedStandbyPubKey, RequestedBy, RunID, and Recipe request data.
Recovery recipes execute through the shared sequential action registry and emit progress/completion events.
Shared failure, cancellation, validation, and per-service serialization semantics apply to recovery and failover runs.
